tests.name: gateway alive after the change (the new task booted with the shutdown handler installed)

tests.reason: The fix runs only when ECS sends SIGTERM to a gateway task with live voice sessions; a staging probe cannot signal a task, and producing a stop row needs a real voice session that writes to the production Supabase project. These suites prove the drain emits one server_shutdown stop + facts end per unreported live session, skips latched sessions, is bounded when a write hangs, never throws, and that the signal handler drains, closes and exits within its bounds. The staging deploy itself (old task SIGTERMed) exercises the handler; a read-only oasis_events check for reason='server_shutdown' after PUBLISH confirms it.
Standing regression suites (CLAUDE.md 42c/42e/42h) stay green; the change touches the gateway bootstrap and the session controller.
